name: Harry Kane

recent_news.headline: Ballon d'Or winner Kane still hunting a Champions League title after losing the 2019 final
facts: Kane says the Champions League is a major goal for him and Bayern this season, and he also wants a trophy with England.
He lost the 2019 Champions League final 2-0 with Tottenham to Liverpool; PSG knocked Bayern out of the competition last season.
ESPN reports he scored 61 goals for Bayern last season.

recent_news.headline: Miroslav Klose has Nuernberg second in the 2. Bundesliga and praises Fuellkrug and Kane
facts: Klose calls Harry Kane a role model for young players and says a team still needs a striker who scores.
Nuernberg are second in the 2. Bundesliga with 24 goals in ten games.

recent_news.headline: ESPN's 10 Best list puts Yamal first, with reigning Ballon d'Or winner Kane only fifth
facts: ESPN's Ryan O'Hanlon ranks Kane fifth, behind Yamal, Bellingham, Olise and Raphinha.
O'Hanlon says Kane is in a finishing slump but contributes more in build-up play than before.

recent_news.headline: Patriots QB Drake Maye says Kane could be an NFL kicker after football
facts: Maye says Kane's dead-ball skill and calm under pressure suit an NFL kicking job.
Kane said in September he would need six months to a year of serious training, and says Bayern come first.

recent_news.headline: Kane becomes England's most-capped men's player with his 126th cap
facts: Kane passed Peter Shilton's 125 caps, a record that stood for 36 years, in the Nations League match against Croatia at Wembley.
Shilton presented him with a plaque, and Prince William gave him a commemorative shirt.

recent_news.headline: Kane thanks acupuncture doctor who revived his career before breaking England's caps record
facts: Kane credits an acupuncture specialist he began working with in 2020, after a run of injuries, for reviving his career.
He was due to take sole ownership of the England caps record with his 126th cap against Croatia.

recent_news.headline: Southgate: Kane isn't a better player than two years ago, just more confident, after Ballon d'Or win
facts: Gareth Southgate told ITV that Kane has not become a better player in two years, but his self-belief has grown.
Southgate says he told Kane after the 2024 final defeat that he would win the league with Bayern, which then happened.

recent_news.headline: Kane leads the Bundesliga in assists and matches his best season total
facts: Kane has eight Bundesliga assists, the most in the league, matching his best-ever Bundesliga season total.
He made two assists in Bayern's 2-1 win at Mainz on 7 November.

recent_news.headline: Kane sets up both goals in 2-1 win at Mainz but is stuck in a four-game goal drought
facts: Kimmich and Lennart Karl scored for Bayern from Kane assists; Tietz scored for Mainz in stoppage time.
Sky says Kane has gone four games without a goal, which has happened only once before in his Bayern career.

recent_news.headline: Kane signs a new Bayern contract to 2029, reportedly above £400,000 a week
facts: Bayern announced on 5 November 2026 that Kane's contract now runs to summer 2029, extending the deal he signed in 2023.
ESPN reports weekly pay above £400,000, while Sky in Germany reports at least about €25m gross per year; the figures are reports, not confirmed by the club.

recent_news.headline: Kane wants his Ballon d'Or displayed in the Bayern museum
facts: Kane told SportBILD he will ask Bayern about putting the Ballon d'Or in the club museum.
He is the first Englishman to win the award since Michael Owen in 2001.

recent_news.headline: Kane parades Ballon d'Or, then misses a penalty as Dortmund snatch a 2-2 draw in Der Klassiker
facts: Kane showed the Ballon d'Or to fans before kick-off; players from both teams applauded him.
He hit the crossbar with a 57th-minute penalty, and Dortmund equalised in the 89th minute to draw 2-2.

recent_news.headline: Kane edges Mbappe for the 2026 Ballon d'Or by 28 points
facts: Kane won with 1,055 points to Mbappe's 1,027, and had 40 first-place votes to Mbappe's 23.
L'Equipe ranked it the fourth-closest vote in the award's 70-year history.

recent_news.headline: Kovac says Dortmund must stop Kane together before Bayern clash
facts: Dortmund coach Niko Kovac calls Kane sensational and says he cannot be stopped one on one.
Dortmund had not beaten Bayern in their last five meetings.

recent_news.headline: Kane's Munich homecoming: guard of honour, a golden schnitzel joke and a knighthood question
facts: Kane received a guard of honour and fan chants at the Allianz Arena, though he did not play in the 6-1 cup win over Magdeburg.
Asked about a knighthood, he said he would not turn one down, though being called 'Sir' would feel odd.

recent_news.headline: Yamal's uncle slams Kane's Ballon d'Or win on Spanish radio
facts: Yamal's uncle Abdul Abdellaoui called the result sad on El Larguero and said Yamal is the best player in the world.
He argued that voters held Yamal's age against him.

recent_news.headline: Kane gets a guard of honour at Bayern training the day after winning the Ballon d'Or
facts: Bayern staff formed a guard of honour as Kane arrived for training on 27 October, and fans chanted his name.
ESPN says he is the first player at a German club to win the award since 1996.

recent_news.headline: Harry Kane wins the 2026 Ballon d'Or at the London Palladium
facts: The men's award was presented at the London Palladium on 26 October 2026; Alexia Putellas won the women's award.
Wikipedia's 2026 Ballon d'Or page lists Kane first, Kylian Mbappe second (1,027 points) and Lamine Yamal third (881 points).

recent_news.headline: Kane equals Shilton's England appearance record in a 3-0 win over Czechia
facts: Kane reached 125 caps, level with Peter Shilton, scoring twice and adding an assist in the 3-0 home win over Czechia.
He has played in all but one of England's last 101 competitive matches.

now: Kane, 33, is a striker and deep-lying playmaker for Bayern Munich and captains England. As of 20 November 2026 he is the reigning Ballon d'Or winner, leads the Bundesliga in assists, and is still chasing his first Champions League title with Bayern. Preview coverage lists him in Bayern's predicted lineup against FC Cologne; the match date and result were not verified in this run.
quick_context: Harry Kane won the men's 2026 Ballon d'Or in London on 26 October 2026, ahead of Kylian Mbappe by 1,055 points to 1,027. He is England's most-capped men's player with 126 caps, having passed Peter Shilton on 12 November 2026. He has said the Champions League is his main goal with Bayern, and he has never won a major international trophy with England.
roast_past: He lost the 2019 Champions League final 2-0 with Tottenham to Liverpool, and he is still hunting that trophy.
He lost the Euro 2020 final (played in 2021) and the Euro 2024 final with England under Gareth Southgate.
When Bayern signed him from Tottenham in 2023 for a reported 120 million euros, Uli Hoeness first called the fee crazy, and later said he would have paid 150 million.
Asked about a knighthood in Munich, he said he would not turn one down, though being called 'Sir' would feel odd.
roast_now: He hit the crossbar with a second-half penalty in the 2-2 draw with Dortmund on 31 October, a week after winning the Ballon d'Or.
He went four games without a goal in October and November, a drought Sky says had happened only once before in his Bayern career.
ESPN's November top-10 list put him fifth, behind Yamal, Bellingham, Olise and Raphinha.
He has said he might switch to NFL kicking, but he would need six months to a year of training and says Bayern come first.
praise: He won the 2026 Ballon d'Or with 1,055 points and 40 first-place votes, against Mbappe's 1,027 points and 23 first-place votes.
He has 156 goals in 161 games for Bayern since joining in 2023.
He is England's most-capped men's player with 126 caps, passing Peter Shilton's 125.
He has eight Bundesliga assists this season, the most in the league.
Southgate says Kane has more belief now, not more ability, than two years ago.
